description: Held-out (clean-room, Noûs for Roberto Locatelli, 2026-09-29). p18's boundary event (prefix digest binds, position binds, attestation reaches the whole prefix) with NO `covered_through`: no coverage is claimed, so there is nothing to compare against the attestation. p18: «the coverage IT CLAIMS is within the prefix its attestation actually reaches» — conditional on a claim. A verifier that requires the coverage field fails this vector.
